handback.title: Every agent's key stays out of public cards and records
handback.summary: Public cards and records hide the key of whichever agent ran, not only Claude's.
handback.user_story: Owners can run a role on any agent without its key ever showing on a card or record.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every workflow step that hides Claude's token also hides the role's agent key.
acceptance_criteria.words: Public logs scrub only Claude's token
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The workflow file is fixed text with no input, so only its steps are checked.

acceptance_criteria.text: The run's record card shows the role's agent key as removed.
acceptance_criteria.words: a key from another secret could leak into transcripts and cards

edge_cases.case: No agent key is set: the record is still written with its text intact.

acceptance_criteria.text: The run's record file saved on the logs branch shows the role's agent key as removed.
acceptance_criteria.words: Public logs scrub only Claude's token, so a key from another secret could leak
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The same record step writes this file; its empty key case is covered by 706.2.

raises.label: Doubt: partly fixed
raises.text: Transcripts already hide the agent key since #719. Should the plan fix only cards and records? It assumes so.
raises.evidence: `.github/workflows/agent.yml` lines 449 and 476 pass `SCRUB_AGENT` since #719; card and record steps do not.
